I've uploaded a code repository in the directory `/src/matio`. Consider the following issue description:

<issue_description>
A heap-buffer-overflow in MatIO: Mat_VarPrint (src/matio/src/mat.c) calls printf/vprintf on a variable name buffer that is not guaranteed to be NUL-terminated (the buffer allocated in Mat_VarReadNextInfo4 in src/matio/src/mat4.c is 32 bytes). printf reads past the end of the allocated buffer (one byte over), causing a heap out-of-bounds read that can crash the program or lead to memory corruption and possible information disclosure or other exploitation.
